Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3bf792ca088881d2acdff20cb1698b42 as of 2026-08-17T06:38:09.352Z: {"title":"Anthropic source library"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🛰️"} **Purpose**: the verified inventory of official Anthropic sources behind everything else in this hub, refreshed on a schedule. It answers *what did we check, when, and what changed* — it is not a second copy of the doctrine. **Operating rule**: this page and its children hold the **register and the change history**. Substantive findings are written into the existing hub pages, never restated here. One home per truth. ## Where findings go
Finding about Written into
Instruction layers, [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md), skills, memory, Cowork/Design surfaces Claude instructions & skills — setup reference
Models, pricing, effort, thinking, prompting, context engineering Models & prompting guide
The wording of our own instruction layers Canonical instruction texts
Which sources exist, when each was last verified, what changed Here
## Scope Official Anthropic-owned sources only: `platform.claude.com`, `code.claude.com`, `support.claude.com`, `privacy.claude.com`, `www.anthropic.com`, `claude.com`, `trust.anthropic.com`, `modelcontextprotocol.io`, and `github.com/anthropics/*`. No third-party blogs, tutorials, or videos. ## Standing rules for each run - Never invent a date. If a page states no publication or updated date, record **not stated** — 114 of 149 current sources are in that category, so `last verified` carries almost all the freshness signal. - Idempotent: update an existing entry in place, never append a duplicate. - Record failures, redirects and dead pages rather than dropping them silently. - A page that returns HTTP 200 is not necessarily still a distinct page — several now serve consolidated content under their old URL. Check the canonical URL, not just the status code. - Write nothing outside this hub. Never edit a `CLAUDE.md` in a code repo. ## Canonical hosts (changed since this hub was last verified) `docs.claude.com` and `docs.anthropic.com` now 302-redirect their entire trees. Current canonical hosts: - [**code.claude.com**](http://code.claude.com) — Claude Code and the Agent SDK - [**platform.claude.com**](http://platform.claude.com) — API, models, pricing, prompting, evaluation - [**support.claude.com**](http://support.claude.com) — Cowork, Claude Design, account and admin - [**privacy.claude.com**](http://privacy.claude.com) — retention and privacy articles (was `privacy.anthropic.com`) ## Current state
